done_today: Today's session is done. Anything more is a bonus.
home_first: Your first session starts with words you already know.
grid_label: Minutes practised per day over the last 28 days
consistency_line: Practised on {days} of the last 14 days · {minutes} min in the last 7 days
weakest_line: Weakest right now: {area}, {pct}% right over the last 30 days ({n} answers).
weakest_none: Not enough answers yet to say what is weakest. A few more days will tell.
retention_line: Words you had seen before: {pct}% remembered ({n} reviews, last 30 days).
lookups_line: Words tapped for help in the last 30 days: {n}. Each one comes back for review.
no_voice: No Greek voice on this computer.
lookup_none: No meaning for “{word}” in your packs yet.
lookup_similar: Closest match: same stem, different ending.
summary_none: No answers this time. That's fine — come back whenever you like.
summary_left: {n} cards of today's session are still waiting. They will be there when you come back.
summary_tomorrow: Tomorrow: {n} reviews, including everything you got wrong today.
nothing: There are no exercises yet. Ask your agent to set up the content.
error: Something went wrong talking to the app. Try reloading the page.
keys_hint: Tip: keys 1–4 choose an answer, Enter goes on. Tap any Greek word to see what it means.
run_failed: The scheduled {skill} run failed on {date}. Your coach will look at it next time you open it; nothing is lost.
run_missing: The scheduled {skill} run has not happened since {date}. Is the computer off at that time?
feedback_ready_writing: Feedback on your writing is ready
feedback_ready_speaking: Feedback on your speaking is ready
tutor_line: Want to practise a conversation? Open your agent and say “tutor”.
write_convert: Turn Latin letters into Greek as I type
speak_hint: Record yourself for about {seconds} seconds. Then listen back and compare with the model answer.
speak_aloud: I said it aloud, no recording
speak_no_mic: No microphone is available. You can still say it aloud.
speak_recording: Recording… press Stop when you are done.
speak_listen_back: Listen back. Keep it, or record again.
speak_saved_line: The recording is saved on this computer. Your coach will listen and tell you what it heard.
write_saved_line: Your coach marks it next time you open your agent and say “coach”. The feedback appears on the home screen.
summary_written: Your writing is saved for your coach.
no_writing: Nothing yet. A writing prompt comes up in the daily session once a week.
feedback_waiting: Your coach has not marked this yet. Open your agent and say “coach”.
score_line: About {points} of {out_of} on the {exam} exam scale
score_estimate: An estimate against the exam's marking criteria, not an official score.
score_estimate_unverified: An estimate against the exam's marking criteria as the coach understands them, not an official score.
table_hint: Type a word or number in each empty cell. Enter moves to the next one.
r_not_scored: No estimate: the app does not score this. It counts once the coach has marked at least 2 of your pieces in exam format.
r_task_missing: No estimate yet: a large part of this section has not been practised at all.
r_not_enough: Not enough practice yet to say: {n} of the {need} first tries needed.
r_estimate: About {est} of {points} (likely between {low} and {high}). Pass line: {line}.
verdict_no_evidence: {exam}: not enough practice yet to say anything about passing.
verdict_pass: {exam}: on this evidence you would pass today.
verdict_fail: {exam}: on this evidence you would not pass today.
exam_open: Exam view: details, plan and mock exams
plan_none: No plan yet. Open your agent and say "make me a plan".
plan_stale: This plan is from {date}. Your coach updates it at the next check-in.
plan_behind: You are behind the plan in {n} week(s). The coach will say what to drop.
candidate_line: {exam} on {date}: {weeks} weeks away, registration closes {closes}. At your recent pace that is about {hours} h of practice; ΚΕΓ's rough guide is {need} h more.
candidate_none: {exam}: no session date has been announced.
pace_line: Your pace over the last 4 weeks: {pace} min a week (your budget: {budget}). Practised so far: {hours} h.
mocks_none: No mock exam is ready. Open your agent and say "give me a mock exam".
r_mock_away: time ran out while you were away
r_untimed: None of this practice was timed: take a mock exam to check the timing.
r_evidence: Based on your first try at {n} exam-format items ({timed} timed), most recent {date}.
coverage_line: {tried} of {available} tried, {unseen} unseen at this level
checked_on: Exam facts checked against the official sources on {date}.
exam_honest: Each section uses only your first try at each exam-format item, so repeating an exercise does not inflate it. Where there is too little evidence, it says so instead of guessing.
exam_legal: Which certificate your residence permit needs is a question for your lawyer or the permit office.
mock_open: in progress: the clock is running
mock_waiting: waiting for the coach to mark it
mock_closed_away: Time ran out while you were away; what you had saved was marked.
mock_total_partial: So far: {points} of {out_of} points. The pass verdict comes when every section is scored.
mock_total_fail: Total {points} of {out_of}: this would not pass.
mock_run_line: One section at a time, each with the real exam's time. The clock keeps running if you leave, as in the exam.
mock_abandon_confirm: Stop this mock? Open sections are handed in as they are.
mock_rules: No feedback until you hand in. You can go back and change answers. If you leave, the clock keeps running.
mock_hand_in_missing: {n} task(s) have no answer. Hand in anyway?
mock_saved_already: Answer saved. Answering again replaces it.
mock_saved: Saved. You can change it until you hand in.
mock_review_hint: Wrong answers come back in your daily sessions.
mock_total_undecided: So far: {points} of {out_of} scored points. Parts that could not be scored (a missing task, speaking without a recording) decide whether this would pass.
check_passed: Lesson check passed: {pct}% (needed {need}%). The next lesson is open.
check_failed: Lesson check: {pct}% (needed {need}%). Not yet: the lesson stays open, and these come back in your sessions.
stage_nothing: nothing to learn by heart here
stage_next: Next: {name}. It opens when 80% of this lesson is learned, or when you pass its check.
map_line: Lessons open one after another. A lesson is done when {pct}% of its words and forms were answered right the last time, or when you pass its check. What you learned keeps coming back for review.
stage_locked_line: This lesson opens after the ones before it.
stage_check_line: The check takes up to 20 questions from this lesson. 80% right and the lesson counts as done.
stage_extra: Plus {n} more general words of this level, which open from here on.
pr_line: Only lessons you have reached. Due reviews come first, then things you have not seen.
w_search: Search in Greek or in your language
w_upcoming: Also show words of later lessons
v_line: Each verb, with the forms you have met. Forms of later lessons are locked until you get there.
stage_secure_line: {n} of them have stuck for {days} days or more.
na_read_line: Each lesson starts with a chapter to read. Its new words come into your sessions once you have read it.
ch_check_note: These do not count towards your exam readiness.
ch_end_line: Practice now covers exactly what this chapter taught. New words are shown to you before they are tested.
ch_flag_thanks: Thanks — the coach will look at it.
ch_none: This lesson has no chapter yet.
stage_read_first: Read the chapter first: this lesson's new words open once you have read it.
book_line: Every lesson starts with a chapter to read: {n} of {total} are written so far. You can read any chapter, also ahead; a lesson's practice opens when you reach it.
ch_end_ahead: You are reading ahead: this lesson is not open yet. Your reading is saved, and its words come into your sessions when you reach it.
ch_done_book: Done reading — back to the book
meaning_other_lang: No English meaning yet; this is the Turkish one.
lookup_phrase: This word is part of the phrase above.
nothing_choose: Nothing of this kind yet in the lessons you have reached. Try another kind, or come back after the next lesson.
